# axm_webhook (Data Source)

Fetches information about a specific Apple Business Manager webhook. The webhook secret is never returned by Apple.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "axm_webhook" "example" {
  id = "webhook-12345"
}

output "webhook" {
  value = data.axm_webhook.example
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The webhook ID.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_date_time` (String) The date and time the webhook was created.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is enabled.
- `event_types` (List of String) The event types to which the webhook subscribes.
- `name` (String) The name of the webhook.
- `updated_date_time` (String) The date and time the webhook was last updated.
- `url` (String) The URL that receives webhook notifications.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
